description: ADO-BATCH cancellation on a client static batch-optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, V, V2, S FROM W ORDER BY ID (read/write copy): stage S of rows 1 and 2, Delete of row 3 and an inserted row (ID 50, Code "w50"); read each row's Status and S; CancelBatch(adAffectCurrent) at row 1 (rows again); CancelUpdate with no edit pending (EditMode, Errors); Filter "ID = 2" with CancelBatch(adAffectGroup) then Filter none (rows); CancelBatch(adAffectAll) (rows, RecordCount); CancelBatch again with nothing pending; then, on a server keyset optimistic Recordset, set S, CancelBatch and CancelUpdate (EditMode, S). Asks what each scope cancels, what an empty cancel reports and how a server cursor answers CancelBatch.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
